 Job Description: 
 
 Job Title: Data Analyst – DSML Team 
 Overview 
 We are looking for a Data Analyst to support the DSML team in advancing projects across computer vision, NLP, and LLM applications. The ideal candidate will be hands-on with data, detail-oriented, and comfortable working across data engineering and machine learning workflows. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Support the DSML team by labeling objects in computer vision projects. 
 Review and evaluate retrieval quality for LLM and NLP projects. 
 Assist in data engineering tasks, including data preparation, transformation, and validation. 
 Help tune model parameters and contribute to improving model performance. 
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure data quality and project success. 
 Required Skills & Experience 
 Programming: Python, Pandas, SQL, Flask, Web Services. 
 Skills: Data Engineering, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Computer Vision. 
 Tools: Google Cloud Platform (GCP), hands-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs). 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail. 
 Ability to communicate findings and collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 
Qualifications
• Min 5 to 7 years of experience
• Bachelor’s Degree or International equivalent   
 
 
 Employee Type: 
 
Permanent
